Lists all Montgomery census tracts with zero listed pharmacies by left-joining every tract to pre-aggregated pharmacy counts and filtering for null or zero counts.
sql:
WITH pharmacy_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_2ae226'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(p.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN pharmacy_counts p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(p.pharmacy_count, 0) = 0
ORDER BY t.name
